narrative: Investors should focus on whether D-Wave can demonstrate that its “real customers” are translating into repeatable commercial growth and broader adoption, rather than merely validating the technology. IonQ’s record guidance and the strong moves in other quantum stocks may provide a favorable sector read-through, but they also raise the bar for D-Wave’s own outlook and execution. The key risks are that the bullish case is already priced in and that B. Riley’s lower target signals reduced near-term expectations, so management’s guidance, customer pipeline, and progress toward sustainable commercialization will matter more than headline enthusiasm. I would expect a closely watched call with potentially volatile shares: positive customer and outlook commentary could reinforce the rally, while cautious guidance or limited evidence of scaling could trigger a sharp reassessment.
